visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Triple Loop Instead of Unrolled Formulas
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each entry of the 2 x 2 product is written out as its own formula. Use the three-loop algorithm with a named size. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The formula for one entry is the same everywhere, only the indexes change, so the loops express it once. Changing N switches to any square size.
